trigger.description: Create a service that runs on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime under the HTTP protocol.

metadata.label: AgentCore Listener
metadata.description: Serves the AgentCore Runtime HTTP protocol: GET /ping and POST /invocations.

section.label: AgentCore Listener
section.description: Attach the agent to a new or existing AgentCore listener.

createNew.label: Create New Listener
createNew.description: Define a new AgentCore listener in the project.

useExisting.label: Use Existing Listener
useExisting.description: Attach to an AgentCore listener already declared in the project.

existingListener.label: Listener
existingListener.description: Select an existing AgentCore listener to attach the agent to.

metadata.label: Listener Name
metadata.description: Provide a name for the listener being created

metadata.label: Port
metadata.description: The port to listen on, or an existing http:Listener to share. Leave it empty to use 8080, which is what AgentCore Runtime expects.

metadata.label: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Service
metadata.description: Handles AgentCore invocations through fixed resources. The listener reads the AgentCore request headers and maps results and errors to JSON responses, so the resources contain only agent logic.

metadata.label: Invoke
metadata.description: Handles POST /invocations: runs the agent for each request and returns its result.

metadata.label: Payload
metadata.description: The JSON request body, bound to the type you declare, such as json or a record.

metadata.label: AgentCore Context
metadata.description: The session, request and user IDs and other AgentCore values of the invocation.

metadata.label: Ping
metadata.description: Handles GET /ping, AgentCore's health check. Keep it cheap and never call the model here.
